newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AUSTRIAN BONDS FIRMER AIDED BY DOLLAR/MARK RATE.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRIAN BONDS FIRMER AIDED BY DOLLAR/MARK RATE.

text.p: Austrian bonds defended a friendly trend to end firmer on Thursday. Traders said the fall of the dollar below 1.88 marks boosted the rangebound German Bund future.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 up five bps at 99.15 to yield 5.74 (5.74) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.16/24 to yield 5.74/73 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 up 20 bps at 99.25 to yield 4.80 (4.85) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.13/21 to yield 4.83/81 percent.
* Austrian bond future up 21 bps at 109.20.
* 10-year spread over Germany steady at seven bps, five-year unchanged at 20.
* Money market rates three-month VIBOR stable at 3.450 and overnight money lower at 3.11/3.36.
